appraisal_events.evidence: Swann avait souvent pensé qu'Odette n'était à aucun degré une femme remarquable, et la suprématie qu'il exerçait sur un être qui lui était si inférieur...
appraisal_events.explanation: Reported as Swann's own habitual judgment, this frames Odette as unremarkable and inferior to him, a private diminishment distinct from her public role in elevating Swann earlier in the same passage.

appraisal_events.evidence: devant Forcheville, qui était maintenant un des fidèles
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator notes in passing that Forcheville has newly become one of the Verdurins' inner circle of «fidèles», marking his inclusion in the salon's valued social space.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's private view of her as unremarkable and inferior mildly diminishes her general appraisal, even as she otherwise dominates the scene through her public avowal to Swann.
His newly acquired status as one of the fidèles marks his inclusion into the Verdurin salon's valued inner circle.
